name: pai-skill-ticktick
description: PAI skill: TickTick CRUD via a thin Bun CLI over the unofficial v2 API.
//: Pinned to the MHoroszowski fork by sha, NOT the npm package. npm `ticktick-client` is upstream's and stops at 0.3.0, so it lacks everything the fork added after the fork point (activity feed, project groups, kanban columns, reminders write-path, MCP parity at 52 tools). The fork commits a prebuilt dist/, so it installs with no build step (bun runs `prepare` for git deps but installs them without devDependencies, so building at install time is not possible without shipping tsup as a runtime dep). To move the pin: push the fork, then swap the sha here and re-run `bun install`. When changing the library: build and commit dist/ in the fork, push, then swap the sha here.
